practicalCriteria: Every one of the 29 fields is completed, or marked not applicable with a reason in the field
Each management and equipment check cites an identifier, tag, measurement or named confirmation
Each negative response is listed in T03 with a reason, a control and an approver
The clearance in f12 shows each factor and the total, using the approved method
The rescue arrangement in T04 names a trained rescuer, a method and equipment on site
Both signatures and dates are present, and every open item has an owner and a date
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: A No answer with no justified control means the work does not proceed
A missing rescue arrangement on site means the record cannot support height work
A record with no worker or supervisor signature is not used
